disposition: Bare offset head overlaps AsphaltNet Eq5. Exact-difference cycle and vote-consensus alone cannot distinguish correct from incorrect target; they are not an admissible target-identification mechanism.
limitations: Does not disprove usefulness of supervised offset regression.
Cycle statement applies to edges defined as exact node differences,not arbitrary learned edge fields.
Additional target-conditioned supervised factors could break degeneracy but require new derivation.
Static formula counterexamples,not native neural gradients or efficacy.
